[stdout]
Share your running app. Improve it together.

Usage:
  purlview [flags]
  purlview [command]

Examples:
  purlview share 3000
  purlview share 5173 8000
  purlview share 3000 --to ana@example.com

Share
  share       Share your running app and print its link
  list        List your active shares
  link        Print a share's link
  stop        Stop a share

Account
  login       Sign in with an email code
  logout      Sign out on this device
  whoami      Show the signed-in account and this device
  devices     List the devices signed in to your account

System
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command

Flags:
  -h, --help      Show help for purlview.
  -v, --version   Show the version.

Use "purlview [command] --help" for more information about a command.
[stderr]
